activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.438 BCE as an explicitly approximate representative Athenian artistic milestone for Phidias. The British Museum identifies him as the artistic director of the Periclean building programme and states that he was certainly active before 438 BCE, when the Athena Parthenos was probably dedicated. The exact chronology of his works remains insecure.
